eyebrow: Runs the moment CI passes on main

code:
deploy-dev:
  needs: build-test-scan
  if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
  permissions:
    id-token: write
  steps:
    - uses: azure/login@v2
      with:
        client-id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_CLIENT_ID }}
        tenant-id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_TENANT_ID }}

    - uses: azure/aks-set-context@v4
      with:
        resource-group: rg-northbridge-dev
        cluster-name: northbridge-aks-dev

    - run: |
        helm upgrade --install product-catalog ./charts/product-catalog \
          --namespace northbridge-dev \
          --values ./charts/product-catalog/values-dev.yaml \
          --set image.tag=${{ github.sha }}
caption: No password, no client secret — a federated OIDC token stands in for both

steps.label: values-dev / staging / prod.yaml
steps.sub: per-environment replica counts and HPA bounds

steps.label: No secrets in values files
steps.sub: External Secrets Operator syncs from Key Vault at runtime

subtitle: Dev deploys on every merge. Staging and prod take a deliberate decision.
